title: Tableau BI Analyst
text: Tableau BI Analyst at SustainAbility Consulting (Sydney, ; Full Time; salary: not stated). About the Company The client is one of the largest multinational provider of cancer and cardiac services. With offices in Spain, UK and Australia. Their purpose is to provide excellence in patient care, deliver superior clinical outcomes and make a significant impact on society. About the Team You will be in the Business Intelligence team reporting directly to the business intelligence team leader. They are very culturally driven. You will be expected to develop strong relationships with individuals, agencies and key stakeholders. About the Job You will be expected to apply appropriate analytical techniques to create information which supports business decision making. You will need to maintain an indepth knowledge of Tableau and the Microsoft BI stack. You will be expected to engage effectively with stakeholders (doctors, agencies, managers) and deliver effective reports on Tableau whilst maintaining strong work ethic and values. Key Skills | Attributes: 5 years experience with business intelligence and analysis Proficient in SSIS SSAS SSRS and Tableau Desktop Server (9-10) Excellent communication and interpersonal skills Python experience (bonus)
